Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure.
On November 23, 2026, TPG Inc. (“TPG” or the “Company”) posted on its website updated supplemental financial information relating to periods on which it has already reported. The updated supplemental financial information reflects the presentation of the Company’s investment platforms under four asset classes: Private Equity, Credit, Real Assets and Market Solutions. Realignment to these four asset classes further involves the following changes: (i) the Company’s Capital, Growth and Impact platforms are now included in the Private Equity asset class; (ii) the Company’s TPG Transition Infrastructure and TPG Peppertree strategies, which were previously included in the Impact and Market Solutions platforms, respectively, are now included in the Real Assets asset class; and (iii) TPG NEXT, which was previously included in the Impact platform, is now included in the Market Solutions asset class. The Company intends to begin using this updated presentation with its financial results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2026. The updated supplemental financial information is provided to assist investors in making comparisons of TPG’s historical performance under the Company’s updated asset class presentation described above. The updated supplemental financial information is accessible through the Investor Relations section of TPG’s website at shareholders.tpg.com. From time to time, the Company uses its website as a distribution channel for financial and other important information.
As provided in General Instruction B.2 of Form 8-K, the information in this Item 7.01 shall not be deemed to be “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section, nor shall such information be deemed to be incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, regardless of any general incorporation language in such filing.
